crypto_keylength_justification: The complete standalone speech configuration uses exact certificate key checks for owned TLS clients and servers, generated RSA3072 CA/RSA2048 leaf keys, CSPRNG bearer tokens and standard TLS1.2+ cipher floors. Real RSA2047 rejection and complete model-to-HTTPS-to-WAV tests pass. Optional Cast/HA transport is explicitly outside this qualified configuration. https://github.com/4alvit/google-home-voice-stats/blob/main/docs/tls-policy.md
crypto_working_justification: The supported speech configuration uses maintained standard TLS1.2+ and SHA256/token primitives. It introduces no known-broken cryptographic algorithm. Vulnerability-remediation status is separately pending Go helper advisory triage. https://github.com/4alvit/google-home-voice-stats/blob/main/docs/tls-policy.md
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Universal cipher and forward-secrecy guarantees across optional device Cast TLS, HA and external release/deployment components have not been established. Private-LAN HTTP and Wyoming also remain explicit compatibility paths. https://github.com/4alvit/google-home-voice-stats/blob/main/docs/tls-policy.md

crypto_password_storage_justification: The application does not store a database of external-user password verifiers. Upstream API credentials are secrets; they are not treated as user password hashes. https://github.com/4alvit/google-home-voice-stats/blob/main/SECURITY.md
crypto_random_justification: Security tokens use Python secrets and/or cryptographic randomness is delegated to the platform TLS library; no custom insecure PRNG is used for keys/nonces. https://github.com/4alvit/google-home-voice-stats/blob/main/igw_google_voice/cast_gateway.py ; https://github.com/4alvit/google-home-voice-stats/blob/main/igw_google_voice/cast_service.py ; https://github.com/4alvit/google-home-voice-stats/blob/main/igw_google_voice/__main__.py
